name: Camazepam
metabolism: Camazepam was broken down extensively in all species investigated to more than 10 metabolites, which were desmethyl, descarbamoyl and/or hydroxy products.
summary: Camazepam is a benzodiazepine psychoactive drug and the dimethyl carbamate ester of temazepam. Its effects are mostly anxiolytic, with comparatively limited hypnotic, anticonvulsant, and muscle-relaxant effects.
